items.description: Verify function signature matches schedule_tasks(tasks: list[str], dependencies: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[str]
items.expected_behavior: Function accepts two parameters (tasks list and dependencies list) and returns a list of strings

items.description: Verify long linear dependency chain maintains order
items.expected_behavior: Long chain of dependencies is ordered correctly from first to last

items.description: Verify diamond-shaped dependency graph resolves correctly
items.expected_behavior: Returns ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'] for diamond graph with a as root and d as sink

items.description: Verify multiple independent chains with lexicographic tie-breaking
items.expected_behavior: Independent chains are ordered deterministically using lexicographic availability

items.description: Verify ValueError raised for duplicate task names
items.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError when tasks list contains duplicate names

items.description: Verify ValueError raised when dependency references unknown task
items.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError when dependency pair contains task not in tasks list

items.description: Verify ValueError raised for circular dependency
items.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError when circular dependency exists (e.g., A->B->A)

items.description: Verify TypeError raised when tasks parameter is not a list
items.expected_behavior: Raises TypeError when tasks is tuple, string, dict, or non-list type

items.description: Verify TypeError raised when dependencies parameter is not a list
items.expected_behavior: Raises TypeError when dependencies is tuple, string, dict, or non-list type

items.description: Verify TypeError raised when task name is not a string
items.expected_behavior: Raises TypeError when tasks list contains non-string elements (int, None, etc.)

items.description: Verify TypeError raised when dependency is not a pair of strings
items.expected_behavior: Raises TypeError when dependency tuple contains non-string elements or is not a 2-tuple

items.description: Verify basic linear dependency chain is ordered correctly

items.description: Verify task names are case-sensitive

items.description: Verify self-dependency is detected as circular

items.description: Verify complex multi-level dependency graph
items.expected_behavior: Correctly orders tasks with multiple levels of transitive dependencies

items.description: Verify empty dependencies list with multiple tasks
items.expected_behavior: Returns tasks in lexicographic order when no dependencies exist

items.description: Verify performance with large task count
items.expected_behavior: Completes within O((N + E) log N) time complexity for large inputs

items.description: Verify every task in input appears exactly once in output
items.expected_behavior: All tasks from input list appear in output list with no duplicates
